name: 91354 · Valencia, CA
findings: ZIP 91354 (Valencia) has 83 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91354 (Valencia) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 91354 (Valencia) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 54% of the typical level).
